query:
UPDATE vampire
    SET user_id = $2,
        status = $3,
        name = $4,
        apparent_age = $5,
        date_embraced = $6,
        torpor_time = $7,
        clan_id = $8,
        covenant_id = $9,
        character_description_url = $10,
        public_knowledge = $11,
        home_domain = $12,
        known_age = $13
    WHERE vampire_id = $1
